title: Position as members
prompt: Members `x` at 0 and `y` at 0 are the robot's position. Write `move_by`, which takes dx and dy and adds them to x and y. In `position_sum`, call move_by(3, 4). Then return x plus y, which is 7.
starter:
var x = 0
var y = 0

func position_sum():
	return x + y

tests.name: Moved by 3 and 4, x plus y is 7

hints: `func move_by(dx, dy):` with `x += dx` and `y += dy`.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var x = 0
var y = 0

func position_sum():
	move_by(3, 4)
	return x + y

func move_by(dx, dy):
	x += dx
	y += dy
